newsitem.title: UK: Ldn Freight - Owner glee as charterers scramble.
newsitem.headline: Ldn Freight - Owner glee as charterers scramble.

text.p: The phenomenal rise of the Baltic Freight Index continued on Friday when it surged 44 points to 1477.
The full extent of this remarkable transformation can be appreciated by the fact that the index stood at 1311 a week ago and at 1000 at the end of September.
Charterers' brokers report difficulty persuading owners to stand by quoted rates, where owners can be persuaded to quote rates against business at all.

Such has been the speed of the market's rise that owners frequently take the view that nothing will be lost by waiting. One owner's broker gleefully described charterers as "screaming for mercy". But Caper and more especially Handy-size owners are only too well aware that this has so far effectively been a Panamax boom only. It is true that Caper rates have gradually strengthened in recent weeks in the Pacific and that brokers report more chartering enquiry emerging in the Atlantic for Capers, but so far the improvement for owners is quite limited compared to that seen for Panamaxes.
Some modest gains have been reported in a few Handy trades but essentially this category has been not yet been seriously affected by the positive developments elsewhere.

Significantly firmer rates were paid in many of the principal Panamax grain trades. US Gulf/Continent lights were believed to have been fixed at $15,75, a smart increase on the rumoured last done of about $14.00 for heavy grain. Secrecy clauses have restricted information reaching the market but Cobelfret as charterers have been active and Diavolezza 75,485 dwt may have been involved.

Giovanni Bottiglieri is understood fixed for 50,000 HSS US Gulf/China for end Nov at $28.50, a jump of $2.00 from Tuesday's reported levels. The critical US Gulf/Japan trade featured reports of Hanjin booking Camarina for 52-54,000 HSS for end Nov at $26.00 no combo, up $1.00 or $1.50 from Thursday's reported rates for Despina. In the East Cho Yang covered 52,500 HSS NoPac/S Korea for Dec 1/10 at a stronger $14.85.

Timecharter rates also appreciated in the grain trades - Hanjin took the 1994-built Samjohn Light 71,756 dwt delivery Continent Nov 25 trip via US Gulf to the Far East at $15,250 daily. On Thursday the similar Torm Tekla 69,268 dwt was reported fixed delivery Morocco mid Nov at $14,750 daily on this run. Rumours circulated of activity by Continental, Nidera and others in the Plate trades, especially to China, but detailed information was lacking. Another couple of over-age Capers were fixed with early delivery Continent on timecharter by grain houses - Mega Brook 123,00 dwt for a transatlantic round by Dreyfus at $10,000 daily and Angeliki 126,000 dwt by IrisL for a trip via the St Lawrence to Iran at between $9,500 and 10,000 daily.

Rumours were heard that Thalassini Axia 164,500 dwt was fixed delivery Japan for a Pacific round at $15,675 daily by Keoyang and Farenco 151,000 dwt for similar business from China end Nov by Pan Ocean at $15,000 daily, but brokers believed they were either incorrect or had failed on subjects. K Line fixed the Halla-relet Oceanic Enterprise 71,259 dwt on subjects delivery Japan mid-Nov for an East Australia round at between $13,250 and 13,500 daily (Halla booked this vessel earlier in the week at $11,000 daily).

Reports circulated that Aimcor had fixed Atlantic Sovereign 8,600 dwt on subjects delivery N Japan mid Nov trip via Long Beach to the Continent with Petcoke at $9,750 daily. If true, this represents an increase of $1,500 daily from Aimcor's rumoured fixture of Mehment Bey 68,789 dwt in this trade a couple of days ago.

Steady rates were reported for some Craned Bulkers in the East. Artemon 38,102 dwt went to S Korean charterers delivery S China for an Australian round at $7,000 DAILY. On the Continent the 1979-built World Amphion 37,428 dwt fixed prompt Tilbury for a trip via the Continent and Baltic to the US Gulf at an impressive $7,450 daily and unnamed charterers booked Atlas 37,635 dwt delivery spot Continent for a trip to the Far East at $10,400 daily. Bulk Taurus 45,654 dwt and Anangel Dignity 41,479 dwt were fixed privately on subjects.
